name: Buddy Tangerine
summary: Light ground #fffaf4, orange accent #ff8424, Bricolage Grotesque over Inter.
note: Cream paper, loud tangerine and a wide friendly grotesque for headlines.

fonts.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.body: Inter, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

light.accent: curated: --orange is the brand colour; --orange-ink (#a64200) is its text-safe variant and is kept as an extra
light.accent_ink: derived: best contrast on the accent out of white, ink and bg

curated.accent: --orange is the brand colour; --orange-ink (#a64200) is its text-safe variant and is kept as an extra

warnings: light: accent on bg is 2.36:1, under 3:1; pair it with a border or use it on a darker panel
